attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The entry carries no asterisk and none of saint.gr's own doubt formulae**: the page does not say his existence, his data or his date is uncorroborated — it says only «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου», that no details of the Russian saint's life are had, which is an absence of material and not a refusal to vouch, and so the entry is drafted rather than refused. **`types` is absent on purpose**: the line gives him only «Άγιος», the corpus's closed list has no slug for a bare saint, and a new type is a code commit and out of a reader's scope. **He is not `aretas-of-nagran`**, the great-martyr of Nagran whom the corpus keeps on 24 October; this one is a Russian of the Altai dead in 1910. **No hymn, no relics, no birthplace, no office, no manner of death.** The page's only outgoing links are to the synaxis of all the saints of Siberia, which is a heading and no folder, and to an OCA page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
